program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((mask (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
                 (lambda (r c) (if (= (at g r c) 0) 0 1))))
         (objs (sort (objects mask 0)
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b)))))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
              ([obj (in-list objs)]
               [i (in-naturals 2)])
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) i))))
